 Join BMW TechWorks Romania on our journey of innovation and excellence as we redefine the future of motion, one product at a time. Our engineers are vital to the innovation and digitalization of BMW Group's driving machines, production, sales and banking processes, and you could be part of our evolving teams.
 What Awaits You
Provide operational support, track update and resolve all assigned incidents, changes and problem reports in the incident management system, ensuring that documentation is thorough, accurate and meets a standard of high quality
Log Incidents accurately and establish and record root cause upon resolution of outages
Properly escalate incidents in a timely manner per support guidelines and procedures
Proactively monitor, recognize, analyze, isolate and/or resolve documented hardware and software problems utilizing a variety of hardware and software testing tools and techniques
Perform deployment and maintenance of network monitoring, analysis and reporting tools
Deliver remote planned maintenance activities in line with the Maintenance Schedule, following documented processes and procedures, including roll back
Manage patch management processes and support remote systems including Citrix, GENUA, and Netsupport Manager
Maintain PXE Network boot functionality, SCANTool, HEAT patch management, and ACRONIS backup and recovery systems
Utilize Deployment Scripting Solution NetUpdate for deployment tasks
Create and maintain documentation as it relates to hardware, network and system configuration, mapping, and processes
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, operations, and quality assurance, to identify opportunities for process improvements and implement solutions to enhance efficiency and productivity
Identify and resolve communication hardware and software related failures and issues
Perform detailed analysis and troubleshooting of network problems and incidents
Oversee/perform new and existing equipment, hardware and software upgrades
Participate in a 24x7 call-out rotation, if necessary
 What Should You Bring Along
Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business or a related field
Minimum 1-3 years of experience on a similar role is required
Expert knowledge in IT infrastructure and related technologies
Experience with client operating systems (Windows 10/11, Linux, Android, Windows embedded)
Scripting knowledge (PowerShell, VBScript, BAT)
Technical experience with Windows (including administration of clients with Windows AD and GPOs)
Familiarity with the creation of desktop images/deployment process, Hardware such as servers, networks, storage etc.,
Server operating systems such as Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft SQL Server, Network and Oracle
Knowledge of corporate networks and ITIL processes and experience
Experience in the automotive industry is nice to have
German language skills are mandatory
Excellent English verbal and written skills

Dynamic and highly-motivating work environment
